gates.q: Are all containers up and returning a live health PASS?
gates.answer: docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Status}}' — all must show healthy. Manual toggle doesn't count.

gates.q: Which of the 27 model keys actually validate, and which are dead?
gates.answer: 24 live, 3 dead. Run validation loop per key against /api/validate.

gates.q: Is /api/tags returning model count > 0 — are models truly pulled?
gates.answer: curl http://localhost:11434/api/tags | jq '.models|length' — currently returns 0. Run: ollama pull <model>.

gates.q: Are all n8n webhooks registered and test-fired successfully?
gates.answer: n8n UI: Webhook node → Test URL. Each of the 4 crew routes must show 200 OK.

gates.q: What's the rollback if a container or key fails mid-deploy?
gates.answer: docker-compose up --scale <service>=0 && docker-compose up -d <service>. Key failure: rotate to backup pool.

gates.q: Who/what runs the boot test on a schedule, not just once?
gates.answer: Cron: 0 */6 * * * — GitHub Actions comet-boot-test.yml every 6h. Results logged to ROITracker.

gates.q: Is the activity feed connected to a real inbound stream yet?
gates.answer: No — currently synthetic. WebSocket or n8n HTTP-polling to Perplexity AI activity endpoint required.

gates.q: Is every dispatch metric REAL or still SYNTHETIC — labeled field by field?
gates.answer: ops_count: SYNTHETIC | gate_progress: REAL | crew_status: REAL | model_keys: REAL | council_seats: REAL

gates.q: Is the remembrance engine wired to persistent storage (survives reload)?
gates.answer: Currently in-memory only. Wire to IndexedDB or POST to /api/memory endpoint.

gates.q: What's the telemetry schema both teams emit into?
gates.answer: {event_id, crew_id, timestamp_iso, action_type, payload_json, confidence_score, data_source, ark95x_approval_required}

gates.q: Is ROITracker.log_task() receiving non-null data?
gates.answer: ROITracker.log_task({task_id, crew, time_saved_min, action_type, source}) — currently receives null. Wire after gate 7.

gates.q: Does the classifier read tab context (URL, title, DOM) reliably?
gates.answer: Chrome extension or browser bridge. window.location.href + document.title on tab switch. DOM: MutationObserver.

gates.q: What's the task-classification taxonomy, and who owns it?
gates.answer: Owner: HERALD. Taxonomy: [search, compose, extract, route, analyze, monitor, vote, escalate].

gates.q: Which model lane is primary/secondary for each task type?
gates.answer: search→llama3 | compose→mistral | extract→codellama | analyze→phi3 | escalate→COUNCIL

gates.q: What happens when classification is ambiguous — fallback rule?
gates.answer: Confidence < 0.65: route to HERALD. HERALD unavailable: default to analyze lane. Log ambiguity event.

gates.q: Who are the 4 real crews — names, roles, assignments?
gates.answer: VANGUARD: Offense | HERALD: Intel/Router | FORGE: Build | WRAITH: Extraction

gates.q: Are crew profile slots filled with real context or still blank?
gates.answer: All 4 crews filled. See crews/ directory. Backstory generator active in dashboard.

gates.q: Are route definitions bound to real endpoint URLs, not placeholders?
gates.answer: 3/8 routes have real URLs. 5 pending. Wire Routes panel shows live status per route.

gates.q: What does each crew have authority to do vs. only suggest?
gates.answer: AUTO: dispatch, log, classify. ARK95X: create routes, merge, publish to surfaces, kill switch.

gates.q: How is the Council vote resolved when seats disagree (dissent)?
gates.answer: Majority: 3 of 5 seats. ARK95X veto on Gate 21 only. Dissent logged with reasoning.

gates.q: What is the single stop-condition that halts deployment?
gates.answer: container_health=FAIL AND model_count=0 simultaneously for > 5 minutes. ARK95X notified. No auto-resume.

gates.q: Which actions auto-execute vs. require your (ark95x) approval?
gates.answer: AUTO: suggestions, logging, routing. ARK95X: crew creation, key rotation, kill switch, surface publishing.

gates.q: What's the kill switch if the system acts on synthetic confidence?
gates.answer: Confidence > 80% on synthetic source → red-flag. All auto-execution pauses. Kill switch arms. ARK95X review.

gates.q: Which surfaces (Notion, Gmail, Drive, ChatGPT, OWUI) are in-scope at launch?
gates.answer: In-scope v1: OWUI (primary), Notion (read/write). Monitoring: ChatGPT. Out v1: Gmail, Drive → v2.

gates.q: What does 'success' measure — time saved, money, risk, or skill — one metric?
gates.answer: North Star: HOURS SAVED PER WEEK. Target: >10h/week by week 4.
